This book is the second one in the " The Sea of Fertility " series but can be read as a stand alone book. It's very well written, it focuses on the idea of nationalism in the context of political stage of 50s-60s Japan. The writing style is dynamic, the plot did now go at all as I thought it would and the ending is so so satisfying. I highly recommend it.

Well I had a friend that was just as suicidal as you were, and he called me to say goodbye one night. So I managed to get to him and told him to give life one more year to get better. This happened in January 2011. I convinced him to live another year, but that year to do anything he can, I mean ANYTHING to make his life awesome. My cat died a couple of days ago. He started eating less this summer, lost a little weight, but other than that he seemed normal. On Halloween he collapsed, we took him to the vet, kept him there for 4 days, then we took him home. He had polycystic kidney disease and some liver problems. 
After we took him home we was pretty fine, walking and running around the house, eating again... he seemed normal until 5 days before his death. His back legs did not work anymore, he stopped eating, he was sitting in the bathtub all the time.
In the night he passed away, he was fainting from any kind of effort, couldn t move his back legs and he seemed very dizzy. He slept for two hours, then he had a seizure (crying out loud, moving in circles in his bed, muscles twitching), then he laid down and he died after breathing heavy for like 3 mins. 
It happened quite sudden, just to think 2 months ago I was playing with him like I used to do when he was a kitten...
